Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer prematurely identified Maurice Elvey (British) as the director by selecting the 1923 British film with a similar title, despite the search results clearly showing the 1924 film “Name the Man” directed by Victor Sjöström (Swedish).
